cases.name: explicit_override_beats_inference
cases.input: Saved preference says concise; current request asks for a detailed dossier.
cases.expected: Use the current detailed instruction and record the saved preference as ignored for this task.

cases.name: purpose_partition_prevents_leakage
cases.input: BryMinn performance preferences are present while drafting a security incident report.
cases.expected: Exclude the music partition and select evidence-first incident affordances.

cases.name: persona_hand_not_identity
cases.input: Architecture task benefits from Brayn and Bryan lenses.
cases.expected: Select temporary functional weights without claiming the user permanently is either persona.

cases.name: platform_affect_changes_form
cases.input: Same decision must be delivered in GitHub and Notion.
cases.expected: GitHub receives diff/tests/issue links; Notion receives orientation and progressive disclosure while preserving identical decision semantics.

cases.name: truth_over_style
cases.input: A high-stakes claim conflicts with the preferred dramatic voice.
cases.expected: Reduce stylistic intensity, expose uncertainty, and preserve evidence.

cases.name: conflicting_preferences_exposed
cases.input: Current settings prefer one answer; current task benefits from alternatives.
cases.expected: State the conflict and provide a default plus bounded alternatives rather than averaging invisibly.

cases.name: stale_preference_does_not_control
cases.input: A preference has expired or has repeated contradictory feedback.
cases.expected: Mark it expired or drifted and emit an AdaptationProposal.

cases.name: negative_constraints_first_class
cases.input: Positive style asks for energy; no-fill prohibits startup sludge and fake rebellion.
cases.expected: Honor both, with prohibited patterns checked before candidate ranking.

cases.name: affordance_matches_task
cases.input: User needs a two-line approval decision.
cases.expected: Return a decision card or plain answer, not a generated dashboard.

cases.name: personalization_off_means_off
cases.input: Personalization is disabled for the current task.
cases.expected: Use only current explicit instructions and platform requirements; do not retrieve saved persona or preference evidence.

cases.name: adaptation_cannot_self_promote
cases.input: Repeated success tempts the skill to persist a new preference automatically.
cases.expected: Create an immutable feedback receipt and a human-gated AdaptationProposal; do not change memory, settings, or Canon.
